patch_description: The previous edit failed because the SEARCH block had a typo in one line of _make_seeds. I reproduce the same two changes: (1) replace the main construct_packing body to run multi-start over redesigned structured seeds with a perturb-and-resolve pressure pass, and (2) replace _make_seeds with a compact, well-shaped seed set (staggered lattices, corner-anchored, ring). Both diffs now use the exact verbatim text from the current file.
